title: Shop
intro: Dress your heroes with coins earned on your adventure.
earnCoins: Earn coins by completing challenges and missions.
syncHelp: Your coins and outfits sync with your player account when you go online. Offline Adventure rewards are kept; purchases require an internet connection after syncing.
freeFramesHelp: These frames are free. Your choice is saved on this device.
frameSaved: Frame equipped! You can now see it in your profile.
purchased: Outfit purchased! You can equip it now.
originalSaved: {hero} is back in their original outfit.
syncPending: Your saved balance is still available. Purchases require a connection; syncing will resume when you go online.
